channel.title: The Celebrity Apprentice
channel.desc: After a festive trip to Lapland, 12 famous faces sled back to London to pitch their Christmas biscuits to supermarket giants and retailers. Both teams rope in famous friends and do their merry best to raise some sweet dough in aid of Children in Need. In the boardroom though, it's all business - and one of the celebs faces the firing finger.
